tools.name: bringup
tools.description: Run the design's bring-up on the board: program base, UART tests against the blind model, program ila, ILA captures, check the design is still alive (flow/bringup.py). Same preconditions as program.

tools.name: build
tools.description: Run the Vivado flow (flow/run_vivado.sh, memory-capped) up to a stage, then the stage gates. until: synth (post_synth reports), place, route (post_route reports), bitstream. variant ila (debug cores from probes.yaml) always runs to the bitstream.

tools.name: check_constraints
tools.description: Check design.xdc against the board: clocks only on the board's clock input, no CLOCK_DEDICATED_ROUTE FALSE, pins and I/O standards as in the master XDC, commands in the XDC allow-list.

tools.name: formal
tools.description: Run the design's SymbiYosys jobs (verif/formal/*.sby): bounded proof and cover.

tools.name: gates
tools.description: Parse a build's reports into stage results (flow/gates.py), or run the verification stage gates (flow/verif_gates.py). Raw numbers and rule ids only.

tools.name: lint
tools.description: Verilator --lint-only -Wall on the design (the build.yaml sources).

tools.name: list_files
tools.description: List files under a directory inside the design directory, or @shell/ (read-only test shell view); at most 500 entries.

tools.name: load_skill
tools.description: Load the frozen bank's skills for this board and family, filtered to bank section ids (SECTIONS.yaml). Returns SKILL.md text as data.

tools.name: program
tools.description: Program the attached board's SRAM (never flash) with the base or ila bitstream, selected by the board's cable serial from the local board file. Needs stage configuration-and-debug, a passing power_ok for the recorded power source, a current build stamp, and hardware budget.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read a text file inside the design directory (any path, including build/ outputs), or the test shell read-only under @shell/ (@shell/rtl/..., @shell/PROTOCOL.md, @shell/host/protocol.py).

tools.name: report
tools.description: Read a named Vivado report or log from build/<variant>/ (for example timing_summary.rpt, power.rpt).

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: BM25 search of the frozen documentation library (no web). Returns chunks as data.

tools.name: simulate
tools.description: Run the design's cocotb tests (tests/test_*_rtl.py) under the chosen simulator.

tools.name: stage_note
tools.description: Append a note to the design's build note (BUILD_NOTE.md) and move the session to a stage.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Write (create or replace) a text file inside the design directory. build/ is read-only.
